title: Chapter 2 · The network map as a 3D city
description: Down into the L1 at Fabra i Puig: the network map is a 3D model of the real Barcelona, every building from OpenStreetMap standing at its height on the streets, parks and sea, the L1, L3, L4 and L5 running over the roofs on posts, stations, names and the famous places drawn upright over it. Then the whole city, the centre where the lines meet, Sants and Plaça d'Espanya, the beach line, and a close look turned round the Sagrada Família.

steps.eval: import('/src/map-markers.ts').then(m => { void window.gerard.travelUI.show('fabra-i-puig', {}, m.cityMarkers({ castle: true, threat: .8, spread: .3 })) }) && undefined
